improve_code_with_llm: use improve_op to generate an improved version of existing code via an LLM given a task description and previous terminal output
improve_code_with_memory: use improve_op with a memory callback to incorporate past journal context when improving code
improve_code_with_complexity_hint: use improve_op with a Complexity enum to guide the LLM toward simple, normal, or complex solutions
improve_code_with_data_preview: use improve_op with a data preview string to help the LLM improve code that processes data
improve_code_with_package_context: use improve_op to improve code with shuffled available packages listed in the LLM prompt for library suggestions
